provenance.attribution: Contains data from UNEP IMEO Eye on Methane / MARS, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Changes: normalized the source and plume CSV tables into JSON; source feedback remains source-level; unresolved plume links are retained; no mitigation confirmation is inferred.

limitations: This is a deterministic evidence-coverage baseline, not a scientific or legal certification.
A source-level notification or feedback record does not establish physical mitigation.
This casebook contains only the selected source and linked plume rows from the cited MARS snapshot.
Feedback fields are source-level and indicate receipt status; they do not contain the underlying response documents.
Feedback, notification, and a later plume-free observation do not by themselves prove physical mitigation.
Unlinked plume rows are excluded from source-specific cases, not assigned to a guessed source.
External evidence entries are link-only references; report content is not copied into this casebook.
Linked report content is not included or independently reviewed.
